mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a luxury bathroom remodel with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a luxury bathroom remodel with AKN Design Group varies based on the scope and complexity of the project. While minor updates might take a few weeks, a comprehensive spa-inspired retreat involving layout changes, custom cabinetry, and specialized fixtures typically ranges from 6 to 12 weeks from demolition to final walkthrough. Our integrated design-build process ensures efficient project management, providing a single point of coordination to streamline scheduling and minimize delays. We emphasize clear communication regarding project milestones and scheduling, ensuring homeowners are consistently informed throughout the process.
